tools.name: open_settings
tools.title: Open Auto Resume settings
tools.description: Show the Codex Auto Resume settings panel, with the current status and every option. Read-only: opening it changes nothing.

tools.name: get_status
tools.title: Auto Resume status
tools.description: Whether automatic recovery is on, whether the watcher is running, how many recoveries are pending, and the current settings. Works with the watcher stopped.

tools.name: list_pending
tools.title: List pending recoveries
tools.description: Interruptions waiting to be recovered, with their exact interruption ids, states and attempt counts.

include_finished.description: Also list recoveries that have already finished.

tools.name: update_settings
tools.title: Change Auto Resume settings
tools.description: Change one or more settings. Only the named settings change. A value outside the allowed range is refused rather than silently adjusted. There is no setting that retries an unclassified failure; do not look for one.

theme.description: Light or dark for the settings window, the popup, the notification card and, while panel_theme is same, the panel. system: Windows there, Codex in the panel.

panel_theme.description: Light or dark for the settings panel in Codex alone: same uses theme's choice, system follows Codex whatever theme is. Changes nothing but colours.

recover_usage_limit.description: Recover interruptions classified as usage limit. Turning this on can never widen what counts as recoverable; the classifier decides that.

recover_network_transient.description: Recover interruptions classified as network transient. Turning this on can never widen what counts as recoverable; the classifier decides that.

recover_timeout.description: Recover interruptions classified as timeout. Turning this on can never widen what counts as recoverable; the classifier decides that.

recover_rate_limit_transient.description: Recover interruptions classified as rate limit transient. Turning this on can never widen what counts as recoverable; the classifier decides that.

recover_server_5xx.description: Recover interruptions classified as server 5xx. Turning this on can never widen what counts as recoverable; the classifier decides that.

recover_stream_interrupted.description: Recover interruptions classified as stream interrupted. Turning this on can never widen what counts as recoverable; the classifier decides that.

recover_auth_service_transient.description: Recover interruptions classified as auth service transient. Turning this on can never widen what counts as recoverable; the classifier decides that.

tools.name: restore_default_settings
tools.title: Restore default settings
tools.description: Reset every setting to its recommended value. Pending recoveries are not affected.

tools.name: pause_auto_recovery
tools.title: Pause automatic recovery
tools.description: Global pause. Nothing is sent while paused. Pausing only ever reduces automation, so it needs no confirmation.

tools.name: resume_auto_recovery
tools.title: Resume automatic recovery
tools.description: Undo a global pause. Recovery then continues under every usual check. This turns automation back on, so Codex asks the user before running it.

tools.name: cancel_recovery
tools.title: Cancel one recovery
tools.description: Stop recovering one exact interruption and anything that continues it. Identify it by the interruption id from list_pending - never by title, project or recency. A continuation already in Codex's queue is withdrawn; one already running is not stopped. Cancelling only ever reduces automation.

interruption_id.title: Interruption id
interruption_id.description: The exact interruption id, as listed by list_pending. Never a title, a project name, or 'the most recent one'.

tools.name: reset_recovery_budget
tools.title: Give an exhausted recovery its attempts back
tools.description: For a recovery that stopped because it ran out of attempts or kept making no progress. It returns to the ordinary waiting state; it does not send anything, and every check runs again.

interruption_id.title: Interruption id
interruption_id.description: The exact interruption id, as listed by list_pending. Never a title, a project name, or 'the most recent one'.

tools.name: start_watcher
tools.title: Start the background watcher
tools.description: Start the watcher if it is not running. Nothing is recovered while it is stopped, so this is the fix when the status says it is not running. It starts the same process the installer starts and decides nothing about any interruption.

tools.name: retry_now
tools.title: Try a waiting recovery now
tools.description: Bring a waiting recovery's next attempt forward. This is not a send: the watcher still revalidates the interruption, still requires the conversation to be open, still waits for usage to be available, and still refuses anything uncertain.

interruption_id.title: Interruption id
interruption_id.description: The exact interruption id, as listed by list_pending. Never a title, a project name, or 'the most recent one'.

tools.name: disable_conversation_recovery
tools.title: Turn recovery off for one conversation
tools.description: Stop automatic recovery for one exact conversation, including its later interruptions, and cancel what it has waiting. Only ever reduces automation.

thread_id.description: The conversation's exact thread id from list_pending

tools.name: enable_conversation_recovery
tools.title: Turn recovery back on for one conversation
tools.description: Let automatic recovery run again for one exact conversation. Nothing is sent by this; every check still applies. This turns automation back on, so Codex asks the user first.

thread_id.description: The conversation's exact thread id from list_pending

tools.name: get_recovery_statistics
tools.title: Recovery statistics
tools.description: Counts of interruptions and how their recoveries ended, and median waits, over the last N days or all time. Content-free.

tools.name: get_recovery_timeline
tools.title: Timeline of one recovery
tools.description: What happened to one exact interruption and everything that continued it: detection, waits, the send, the turn it started and how that turn ended. Codes and times only.

interruption_id.title: Interruption id
interruption_id.description: The exact interruption id, as listed by list_pending. Never a title, a project name, or 'the most recent one'.

tools.name: clear_recovery_history
tools.title: Clear recovery history
tools.description: Hide finished recoveries from the history. Deletes nothing and cancels nothing; a recovery that may still change stays visible, and hidden ones still count for every safety check.

tools.name: preview_recovery_message
tools.title: Preview the recovery message
tools.description: Show the exact text Codex Auto Resume would send to continue a task after an interruption of the given kind, under the current settings or the language and style given. Read-only: it saves nothing and sends nothing.

category.description: The kind of interruption to preview.

changes.description: Unsaved choices to preview with. Nothing is stored.
